specs.Camera Lens: Wide-angle lens with 140° field of view, suitable for capturing expansive landscapes or group shots in tight spaces.

features: High-Resolution Imaging - Capture sharp and clear videos with this thumb-sized portable camera, featuring 4K resolution. Equipped with a 140° wide-angle glass lens, it offers a broader field of view and excellent light transmission, reducing image distortion. Perfect for capturing expansive landscapes or group shots in tight spaces, this camera delivers vivid, detailed visuals.

128GB Storage & Long-Lasting Battery Life - Enjoy ample storage with the built-in 128GB memory card, allowing up to 24 hours of H.264 footage. An additional external card slot provides flexibility, while the included card reader ensures easy data transfer. Powered by an 800mAh battery, the camera supports up to 90 minutes of continuous use, perfect for long recording sessions without the need for frequent recharges.

Versatility at Your Fingertips - Designed for portability and convenience, this mini camera comes with a 360° swivel detachable clip and a magnetic lanyard, allowing easy attachment to clothing or bags for hands-free use. Its powerful magnet and stable stand design make it ideal for mounting on metal surfaces or flat areas, providing flexibility in capturing different angles.
description: The camera’s loop recording function automatically overwrites the oldest footage when the memory card is full, ensuring uninterrupted recording. It is equipped with a fully waterproof casing, providing reliable underwater performance up to 66 feet (20 meters), making it perfect for aquatic adventures, while still offering protection in all weather conditions.
